title: The 4 Best Dog Beds for Chewers
h1: The 4 Best Dog Beds for Chewers
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for dog beds for chewers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dog beds for chewers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Kuranda Chewproof Elevated Dog Bed
products.blurb: Key specs: PVC frame rated to 250 pounds, Ballistic-grade Cordura or vinyl fabric, No foam or stuffing to tear apart.
strengths: No loose foam or stuffing gives a destructive chewer nothing to pull apart and scatter
PVC frame and ballistic fabric resist scratching and gnawing far better than soft fabric beds
Replaceable fabric panels extend the bed's life even if a determined dog eventually wears through one
Elevated platform also keeps dogs off cold or hot floors
limitations: No foam means less joint support for senior or arthritic dogs
Rigid frame takes up more fixed floor space than a soft mat
features: No foam or stuffing to tear apart
Made in the USA with replaceable fabric

products.name: PetFusion Ultimate Dog Bed
products.blurb: Key specs: YKK zippers on both foam and bolster compartments, Solid 4-inch memory foam base, 35% cotton breathable cover.
strengths: YKK zippers resist a dog's teeth and paws better than standard plastic zippers
Solid foam base is harder to pull apart in chunks than loose fiber fill
Still provides real joint support unlike foam-free elevated beds
limitations: Not marketed or built as chew-resistant, a determined chewer can still reach the foam
Fabric cover itself is still vulnerable to scratching and gnawing
features: YKK zippers on both foam and bolster compartments

products.name: Furhaven Orthopedic Dog Bed Jumbo/XL
products.blurb: Key specs: Egg-crate orthopedic foam base, Removable, machine-washable cover, Jumbo/XL size for dogs up to 95 pounds.
strengths: Low enough price that replacing a destroyed bed is not a major loss
Washable cover handles the mess of a partially chewed bed until replacement
Large size and soft cover still gives a non-chewing housemate real comfort
limitations: Not chew-resistant in any way, a determined chewer will destroy it quickly
Foam scatters everywhere once a dog gets into it, creating cleanup and a choking risk
Should not be left unsupervised with a known destructive chewer
features: Jumbo/XL size for dogs up to 95 pounds
